Great service, mixed on the food
Sep 2026 • Couples
We made a reservation at A Taste of Saigon's Ben Thanh location but accidentally showed up at their old market branch instead — my mistake, as they have more than one location and I hadn't realized it. Despite the mix-up, the staff were fantastic about it. Harry took great care of us and managed to seat us upstairs even though the reservation was technically for a different spot. Really appreciated the flexibility and friendly service.

A heads up for anyone visiting: this location isn't easy to find. It's next to Phatty's Expats Bar, down an alleyway you need to walk to the end of. Worth knowing before you go so you're not wandering around.

Harry was incredible throughout the meal — he repeated our order back to make sure it was right, the food came out fast, and he even double-checked the bill before we paid. That kind of attention to detail made a big difference.

We ordered the fresh spring rolls with pork & shrimp (Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt), which came out average — maybe my expectations were just a bit too high going in.

The standout was the broken rice in coconut with grilled chicken (Cơm tấm trong trái dừa với gà nướng) — the rice actually arrives served inside the coconut, which was a fun presentation, and the chicken was perfectly cooked and boneless. Really well done.

Tip for future diners: make sure you know exactly which A Taste of Saigon location your reservation is at before heading out, since they're not all in the same place. After your meal, it's worth walking over to Monobooth for some photos. Service made up for the food being just okay, and we'd consider going back.
